status: frozen after schema and document inspection, before assessment or group ranking
scope_of_this_file: The incident log of BPI Challenge 2013. The open-problem and closed-problem logs of the challenge are not part of this repository.

criteria.name: Immediate return to prior support team (compressed A-B-A)
Repeated substatus observations beyond first occurrence
Long observed trace span (not resolution or service-level time)
Active status observed after Completed (not certified failed resolution)

view_weight_policy: Each criterion receives its layer's stated raw weight; these are per-criterion weights, not target layer totals.
ordering: Parse all timestamps as UTC; sort by timestamp, then original event position. Sequence criteria are unavailable when any timestamp is invalid or when tied timestamps carry different relevant sequence values. A missing team or status is never dropped to join the surrounding observations.
grouping: Stable product across all events of the incident; otherwise an explicit missing or multiple-values label. No responsible owner is assigned.
tie_policy: descending Priority Index, then descending number of scored cases, then ascending group key
claims: Illustrative recorded concerns; no service-level compliance, actual cost, causal ping-pong, wait-user abuse or fault of closure is established.
